Chain Of Rain Storms Moving Into Santa Clarita

Posted by: Louie Diaz in Santa Clarita Latest News, Weather November 12, 2026 - 2:10 pm
Listen to audio version of this article
Instaread
Sponsored by

A chain of storms is moving into the Santa Clarita Valley, bringing the chance of wet weather through most of next week.

Rain showers are set to start moving into the Santa Clarita Valley Thursday night, said Bryan Lewis, a meteorologist with the National Weather Service (NWS).

“We should see some rain starting probably late tonight, maybe after most people go to sleep,” Lewis said.

Officials with the NWS say showers could last through the morning.

By Friday evening, more rain is expected.

“We’ll see a second round of rain at some point, likely Friday afternoon, or maybe in the evening hours and continuing overnight,” Lewis said.

Officials say rain is set to be light with no major downpours. Santa Clarita could see about a quarter inch of rain.

Most of Saturday and Sunday are expected to be dry before a second storm system moves into the area Sunday night, according to Lewis.

“Sunday night at the earliest continuing into Monday, we should see another round of relatively light rain,” Lewis said.

And the last storm system that is expected to hit the Santa Clarita Valley next week is set to arrive Wednesday, according to Lewis.

All three storm systems are expected to bring the same amount of rainfall to the area, according to NWS officials.

The storm systems are also expected to cause temperatures to drop with daytime highs in the upper 50s to lower 60s.

About Louie Diaz

Louie was born and raised in Santa Clarita. At the age of two Louie lost his vision due to a brain tumor. However, Louie doesn't let blindness stop him from doing what ever it is he wants to accomplish. Growing up some of his favorite hobbies were wood working, fishing and riding bikes. Louie graduated from College of the Canyon in December of 2017, with a Broadcast Journalism degree. Growing up Louie has always wanted to be a fire fighter or a police officer, but because of his blindness Louie knew that wouldn't work. Louie has always loved listening to police and fire radio traffic, using a scanner, and he figured if he was going to listen to the scanner so much, he should do something with it.
